rows.ja: 大径棒鋼・継目無管の競合(10-Kに記載)
rows.en: Large bar & seamless tube competitors (named in the 10-K)

relations.text: 2014年にティムケンの鉄鋼事業が分離独立して誕生
relations.text_en: Spun off from Timken's steel business in 2014

source.label: Metallus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: became an independent, publicly traded company as the result of a spinoff from The Timken Company ("Timken") on June 30, 2014.

relations.text: 継目無機械管の主な競合
relations.text_en: Primary competitor in seamless mechanical tubing

source.label: Metallus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For seamless mechanical tubing, offshore producers such as Tenaris, S.A., Vallourec, S.A. and TMK Group are our primary competitors, as well as the foreign-owned domestic producer ArcelorMittal Tubular Products (a unit of Luxembourg-based ArcelorMittal, S.A.).

relations.text: 6インチ未満の棒鋼の主な競合
relations.text_en: Primary competitor for bars under 6 inches

source.label: Metallus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For bar products less than 6-inch in diameter, the primary competitor is foreign-owned domestic producer Gerdau Special Steel North America (a unit of Brazilian steelmaker Gerdau, S.A).

companies.name: スチール・ダイナミクス

relations.text: 9インチ以下の棒鋼の主な競合
relations.text_en: Principal competitor for bars up to 9 inches

source.label: Metallus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For bar products up to 9-inch in diameter, domestic producers Steel Dynamics, Inc. and Nucor Corporation (in some cases up to 10-inch) are our principal competitors.
